$comment: Test manifest for scripts/run-tests.js. Each test runs as `node scripts/<script or name>.js [args]` from the playground root and passes by exiting 0. "all" runs every tier except all.excludeTiers.

tiers.fast: npm test: quick, deterministic, high-value checks (about 3-5 minutes on 32 cores)
tiers.ui: menus, shop, HUD and other interface flows in the browser
tiers.game: rules and simulation: movement, supply, combat, naval, map generation
tiers.ai: AI behaviour checks (owned by the AI-merge agent; slow, not yet on the harness)
tiers.manual: needs real external services or hardware; run by hand
tiers.stale: tests that already failed on the shipped game before the 2026-11-14 clean-up; kept for repair, not run by test:all

verify-battlefield-geography.desc: Each authored battlefield is distinct, with its own waterways, town layout, roads and landmarks (no browser).

verify-desktop-multiplayer.desc: Relay URL choice for browser, LAN, Steam and public web builds (--desktop / --live add the packaged app and live relay).

verify-no-secrets.desc: Release credential guard: no keys or tokens in the shipped files.

verify-no-secrets.test.desc: Unit tests of the credential guard (synthetic keys, redaction, UTF-16, ASAR, file names).

verify-profile-identity.desc: Profile store on PGlite, device identity, Steam OpenID linking and the stable desktop origin.

verify-sound-bank.desc: All 60 era sound effects decode with consistent loudness, headroom and length (ffmpeg).

music-credits.desc: Music playlist, shipped files and credit documents agree (sync-music-credits --check).

civ-svgs.desc: Civilisation emblem SVGs are well-formed 512x512 documents.

verify-startup.desc: Real boot: splash, menu battle, skirmish and back, warm reload, and recovery from an injected menu-battle fault.

verify-changelog-recovery.desc: The what's-new popup recovers from missing or broken changelog data.

verify-gold-coin.desc: Starting gold, the credits gold-coin secret, a shop purchase and the cloud merge.
verify-gold-coin.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: expects 200 starting gold; new profiles start with 100. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-gold-rewards.desc: Match gold rewards, era skin names and the progress reset dialog.

verify-mobile-specialists.desc: Phone layout: specialist skins, previews and wrapping button rows.

verify-terrain-ui.desc: Terrain UI, and hostile regiments keep blocking a mountain pass.

verify-terrain-hd.desc: HD terrain paints every point without gaps; terrain style switches and persists through the shop.
verify-terrain-hd.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: expects atlas_hd as the default map pack; the default is now "default". Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-intel-stats-aerial.desc: Faction intel, scouting, fog reveal, detailed statistics and responsive layouts.
verify-intel-stats-aerial.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on an older stats layout. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-orders-siege-ui.desc: Order buttons and the siege UI; map clicks below the unit details; shift adds to the selection.

verify-store-refresh.desc: Every catalog mission loads through the launcher; a purchased mission is used up only by a victory.
verify-store-refresh.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on an older store flow. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-editor-scenarios.desc: Map editor scenarios: save and load, title and victory settings; live edits leave the library alone.

verify-board-packs.desc: Map board packs render in every era and class, with safe ownership and cache reuse.

verify-lifetime-stats.desc: Lifetime statistics survive a surrender and an immediate reload.

verify-coasts-menu-garrisons.desc: Coastal claims, a fresh menu snapshot after a second match, and garrisons.
verify-coasts-menu-garrisons.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older garrison behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-historical-campaigns.desc: Every authored historical battlefield previews, loads and keeps its objectives.

test-dev-menu.desc: The developer menu opens with a triple backtick, grants gold and closes with Escape.

test-store-dday.desc: Buy the D-Day mission in the shop, find it in the mission list and start it.
test-store-dday.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: the page context is replaced when the mission starts. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

test-normandy-v2.desc: The Normandy D-Day mission loads with its towns, named units and briefing.
test-normandy-v2.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: the page never reaches network idle. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-multiplayer-spectating.desc: Multiplayer spectating and host hand-over, against the real relay (server/index.js).
verify-multiplayer-spectating.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: timing race; passed 1 of 3 runs on the old build too. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-xp-multiplayer-profiles.desc: XP, password retry, host surrender, disputed results, rejoin and relay restart, against the real relay.

verify-spectating.desc: Spectating the rest of a battle after a single-player defeat.

verify-archipelago-logistics.desc: Island logistics: ferry travel windows and supply across water.

verify-assault-bridges.desc: Assaults across rivers build bridges and never claim bridge-deck cells.

verify-assault-commands.desc: Right-click and group assaults, era move cues, persistent mixed assaults and coastal raids.
verify-assault-commands.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: asserts AI assault behaviour and audio cue counts from an older build. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-attack-pursuit.desc: Attack orders keep after a retreating target.

verify-bridge-water-attrition.desc: Bridge crossings and water attrition with physical movement.

verify-build-feedback-performance.desc: Build orders give feedback in the same frame and are routed without frame spikes.
verify-build-feedback-performance.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older build-notice behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-campaign-skirmish-bridges.desc: Bridges on campaign and skirmish maps work for both sides.

verify-city-supply.desc: City supply: corner contacts cut, stair-step corridors supply, recaptured pockets.
verify-city-supply.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older supply rules. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-coastal-combat.desc: Combat between land units and ships along coasts.

verify-coastal-group-movement.desc: Group moves along coasts keep formation and stay on land.

verify-command-update.desc: Broad regression: openings, purchases, groups, production, AI, campaign, painting and the 60-clip audio mix.
verify-command-update.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on an older command HUD. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-crossings-traffic-trade.desc: River crossings, road traffic and trade convoys.

verify-diagonal-fronts.desc: Diagonal fronts: corner-touching pockets need a full ring; thin corridors stay intact.
verify-diagonal-fronts.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older frontline rules. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-diagonal-retreat-buildings.desc: Retreats along diagonals and around buildings.

verify-feedback-supply-front.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older supply/idle-reserve behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-frontline-performance.desc: Rounded political borders, supply transitions and the incremental AI scan without false supply warnings.
verify-frontline-performance.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: timing budget from an older build. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-generation-quality.desc: Map generation rejects poor layouts before armies or previews are published.

verify-group-movement.desc: Large groups reach fixed slots without overlaps, illegal terrain or goal changes.

verify-islands-reports.desc: Island maps, and the match report when the local player is not faction one.

verify-line-routes.desc: Line orders: spread, spacing and planning time for up to 160 units.

verify-medical-command.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older medical AI behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-naval-healing-encirclement.desc: Naval repair, live topology and attrition ticks in encirclements.
verify-naval-healing-encirclement.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older naval healing rules. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-naval-operations.desc: Naval pointer and formation orders, and a defended invasion from a fresh match.
verify-naval-operations.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older naval AI behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-naval-pressure.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older naval AI behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-naval-transports.desc: Naval combat, healing, ferry trips, spacing and AI water preferences.
verify-naval-transports.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older transport behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-partitions-movement-supply.desc: Movement and supply across map partitions and a biome checkerboard.

verify-preview-coast-borders.desc: Map preview borders follow the real coastline.

verify-push-cover.desc: Hospital combat, wide supply defence and fog.

verify-retreat-shore-city.desc: Retreats to shore cities use the native movement and combat.

verify-specialists-commanders.desc: Specialists (motorized, mountaineers) and commanders: paths, production, persistence.
verify-specialists-commanders.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: assertion on older commander behaviour. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-starting-supply.desc: Seeded maps start with connected supply and balanced land.

verify-strategy-rewards-speed.desc: Strategy rewards and game speed controls.

verify-support-orders.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: the transport landing step fails the same way on the old build. Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-targeting-morale-speed.desc: Targeting, morale and speed; the info overlay stays usable.

verify-water-siege-spacing.desc: Sieges by water and unit spacing; the AI retries after a search cooldown.

test-mapgen-speed.desc: Map generation for one to three AIs finishes inside the hang limits.

verify-steam-commerce.desc: Steam commerce: orders, entitlements, gold bundles and the in-game Supporter Pack (no browser).

verify-steam-store-ui.desc: Steam store UI against the commerce API and a fake native bridge, plus a gameplay smoke pass.

verify-hd-cosmetics.desc: Atlas HD cosmetics, entitlements and connected terrain/fog visuals.

verify-campaign-command.desc: Campaign command: roster, recruitment and orders.
verify-campaign-command.stale: Already failed before 2026-11-14: AI assembly check from an older build fails before the campaign part (which passes). Fix, then put staleFrom back as tiers.

verify-steam-sandbox.desc: Real Steam client and the live sandbox backend; opens a checkout. Run by hand only.

cache-stamps.desc: Every script and stylesheet in index.html carries the current content-hash cache stamp (npm run stamp).

verify-ai-difficulty.desc: AI difficulty: chosen in skirmish setup and the campaign, applied to the match and shown in the battle report; commanders are random and never shown; the AI treats every enemy alike and pays unpaid upkeep like a player.

verify-encircled-morale.desc: A routed regiment cut off in a pocket regains no morale and does not rally while cut off; it runs for supplied ground and recovers once out (computer faction and player).

verify-stop-order.desc: The Stop order (unit card button and H): selected units drop their march, queued move and attack order and hold where they stand; routed and enemy units are not stopped; the orders row fits at desktop and phone width.

verify-water-exit.desc: Land units in the water walk back out: ordered ashore from 1-6 cells out, in a group, from a one-cell channel and a lake; left in the water with no order they wade to the nearest shore, a routed one too; sent into the water on purpose they stay.

verify-route-display.desc: The route drawn for a marching unit starts at the unit and never reaches back over ground already passed; a deselected unit shows only the leg to its next waypoint, a selected one the whole route.

verify-traffic-sidestep.desc: Units meeting under crossing orders step out of each other's way: head-on groups in the open and in a pass, two groups to one spot, a column through a parked group and across a marching column all arrive without straying more than four cells.

verify-ai-chokepoints.desc: The AI holds a two-cell mountain pass: its waiting army stands on its side of it, and with an enemy force approaching its town beyond the pass it holds the pass in front of the town; with the choke switches off it does neither.

verify-ai-fight-bridges.desc: The AI bridges from its own island to a fight on another island (no enemy town there); with fightBridges=0, with no fight across the strait, or with the fight on its home island it builds none.

verify-cross-water-orders.desc: Land troops ordered to dry ground across a strait go there: one infantry, a tank, a group of four and a drawn line all get slots on the island clicked, cross and stand on it; with a causeway close by the infantry walks round by land and never gets wet; across a bay it walks round to the two-cell crossing instead of swimming six cells straight over.

verify-bridge-diagonals.desc: Bridges are limited by the four cells of water they cross, the same in every direction: straight, slanted and full-diagonal crossings of a three-cell river and a five-by-five diagonal over four cells are allowed, five cells are too long either way, and infantry walks over a diagonal deck dry.

verify-front-supply.desc: Troops pushed into enemy land stay supplied while a way back passes no ground the enemy troops hold: six cells in with nobody about, or beyond an enemy line through a gap one of ours holds; an enemy line with nobody in the gap, an enemy ring, or thirty cells deep cuts them off; a patch of our land is an encircled pocket only with enemy troops round it.

verify-town-siege-rule.desc: A town stops recruiting and building only when the enemy has taken a town cell, stands on one, or fights our troops standing in it; an enemy two cells off, or a fight just outside the town, leaves it working.

verify-mp-lobby-switch.desc: Over a local relay: with a guest in the lobby the host regenerates the map, closes the map dialog unapplied and applies a new shape; the match launches on it for both, and the guest draws gunfire like the host. A guest that cannot load the host map lands on the main menu while the AI takes its seat.

verify-canvas-recovery.desc: When the system takes the map canvases back and returns them blank, the map is drawn again with one notice instead of staying black.

verify-bridge-shared-ends.desc: Bridges may share a landing: fans from one bank at 37-45 degrees, two meeting at the far bank and bridges end to end across an island are allowed and walked over dry; the same span, decks side by side, a crossing over the water or a fan under 35 degrees are refused; a town on the bank is named as the obstacle.

verify-ai-last-stand.desc: An AI about to lose its last town throws everything into the fight, the far flanks and a wounded unit by a hospital too (not with lastStand=0), and its other town raises troops with all the money; a scout near a strong one-town AI, or an AI with three towns, is no last stand.

verify-naval-land.desc: Ships stay on the water: a warship card is a tank card's size (old saves at radius 20 load at 16); an enemy warship at the beach neither holds the shore against supply and claims nor blocks or pushes troops walking past it or ordered to the cell beside it; a unit in the water is still pushed off a ship.

verify-ai-land-bridges.desc: On a land map the AI finds the crossing of a river that is the whole border, toward the town it is going for, and builds it with the bridge price and one regiment in hand while saving for something else; with landBridges=0 it does not.

verify-waypoint-selection.desc: Shift-click waypoints belong to the units given them: a marching unit selected after another keeps its own route and extends it, never the other unit's waypoints; a group starts from its own marches.

verify-map-balance.desc: Starts are even on all eight map shapes for two to four players: equal towns, the same share of forest, hills, swamp and sand (within three points) and of mountains, no river between some players only, and nearest enemy towns about as far for everyone; fixtures for river filling and terrain evening.

verify-archipelago-fairness.desc: Archipelago starts are fair island by island: fixtures for a lone town against two, even shared islands and a player safe on his own island; real two-, three- and four-player maps have equal towns on every shared island and per player.
